author: Michael Larabel
description: The ReactOS project that is striving to be the "open-source Windows" with Windows driver and software binary compatibility hit another milestone today.  ReactOS to date has primarily targeted Windows NT 5.2 as the architecture from Windows XP and Windows Server 2003 but with an eye toward Windows NT 6.0 for Windows Vista and later compatibility with software. ReactOS has now landed their first NT6 system call...
title: ReactOS Implements First Windows NT6 System Call In Step Toward Vista Compatibility

author: Michael Larabel
description: A change proposal under consideration for Fedora Linux 45 would enable x86_64 Shadow Stack usage by default in the name of better security on modern Intel and AMD systems...
title: Fedora 45 Considering x86_64 Shadow Stack Usage By Default

author: Michael Larabel
description: The EFS file-system was used for non-ISO9660 CD-ROMs and disk partitions on SGI IRIX before IRIX 6.0 switched over to XFS. Inside the Linux kernel has been a read-only EFS file-system driver without a maintainer for 20+ years while for Linux 7.3 it's expected to be removed...
title: EFS File-System Slated For Removal With Linux 7.3 After 20+ Years Unmaintained

author: Michael Larabel
description: When AI/LLM agents are used in the creation of Linux kernel patches, the policy for a while now has been that it should be specified using an "Assisted-by" tag as part of the patches/commits. But Linux kernel developers this week have been discussing whether to revise that policy or to potentially eliminate it...
title: Linux Kernel Developers Again Discussing AI Agent Attribution - Potentially Dropping It

author: Michael Larabel
description: Since May we have been benchmarking the SpacemiT K3 RISC-V SoC as one of the first to market RISC-V chips supporting the RVA23 profile. The SpacemiT K3 has shown how far RISC-V performance has come in the past half decade and one of the promising elements of this modern RISC-V SoC with its X100/A100 cores is supporting the RISC-V Vector Extension "RVV" 1.0. In this article are some initial benchmarks looking specifically at the RISC-V RVV 1.0 performance impact in different supported software.
title: RISC-V RVV Vector Performance Benchmarks With The SpacemiT K3 SoC

author: Michael Larabel
description: The x86 Ecosystem Advisory Group led by Intel and AMD recently firmed up the AI Compute Extensions (ACE) specification for optimizing x86 for AI computation tasks around matrix multiplication and the like for machine learning workloads. The cross-vendor ACE extension is ultimately a successor to Intel's Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). Posted to the GCC mailing list today by Intel engineers are the initial patches in preparing the compiler support for ACE...
title: Intel Posts Initial GCC Compiler Patches For AI Compute Extensions "ACE"

author: Michael Larabel
description: One month ago we reported on YSERVER as a modern X11 server written in Rust with the help of Claude Code. Since then YSERVER has continued to advance in supporting more X11 functionality thanks to the help of Claude Code (AI) and out today is version 1.3 o this display server...
title: Vibe Coded X11 Server Written In Rust Adds Xinerama, FreeBSD Support & Other Features

author: Michael Larabel
description: A security disclosure has been made public today for a yet-to-be-patched arbitrary code execution vulnerability with the KDE Plasma desktop...
title: KDE Plasma Affected By Arbitrary Code Execution To Break Sandboxes With "Open New Window"

author: Michael Larabel
description: It's not only old x86 i486 CPU support being removed from the Linux kernel but a number of older ARM platforms and features are on the chopping block too. A proposal has been laid out for deprecating and then removing a number of outdated ARM platforms and features from the Linux kernel in early 2027...
title: Linux Looking To Retire A Number Of Old ARM Platforms In Early 2027

author: Michael Larabel
description: A new release of libjxl is now available for this reference implementation of the JPEG-XL image format, including both image encode and decode support...
title: JPEG-XL libjxl 0.12 Brings More Performance Optimizations

author: Michael Larabel
description: Erin Catto who has been developing the Box2D 2D physics engine for games announced the release of Box3D. Box3D is now providing a new open-source 3D physics engine that is forked off from the Box2D code...
title: Box3D Debuts As New Open-Source 3D Physics Engine
